title: Data Engineer - Oracle PLSQL, Data Analytics, Geo Postal Data Maintenance
teaser: Take on the role of Data Engineer to deliver accurate and timely data for Cisco operations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, conduct advanced data analysis, and maintain geo postal data. Ideal for candidates with strong SQL, PL/SQL, and data analytics expertise, and experience in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
description:
Meet The Team 
 

Our team works in a fast-paced, complex environment. We have the opportunity and obligation to provide accurate and timely foundation data to different functions across Cisco. In this role, you will work very closely with Ops delivery lead on Customer and partner Data Operations to ensure smooth and efficient operations. You will also get to work with several cross functional stakeholders, vendors, technical IT teams, senior leadership and customers / partners. We are a highly collaborative and energetic team focused on innovation and thought leadership.  

Your Impact 

Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical abilities, including advanced data analysis skills using MS Excel/Access, Oracle SQL, and PL/SQL.

Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover trends, identify anomalies, and highlight business opportunities.

Demonstrates excellent verbal and written communication skills, as well as effective business partnering capabilities.

Validates data from various third-party sources and develops strategies for optimal utilization.

Applies AI techniques such as predictive analytics, LLM, NLP, and intelligent data enrichment.

Possesses solid business knowledge, enabling the integration and extraction of data from multiple sources to support solutions with high data integrity.

Adopts a problem-solving mindset and collaborates effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

Connect with different stake holders, cross functional teams, Ops teams and IT teams for understanding data issues and fixes

Self-motivated, results-driven, proactive, and adaptable; able to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while being a collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills.

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a relevant field

Minimum 4 to 8 years data delivery experience

Proven experience achieving business outcomes, in a fast paced highly cross-functional organization

Proficient in SQL, PL/SQL for data analysis

Strong knowledge on Geo Postal data maintenance

Strong Agile (Scrum) experience 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience working in AI-powered analytics solutions that improved business decision accuracy and reduced manual reporting effort.

Strong understanding of Cisco’s Go to Market Strategies.

Previous experience in Cisco tools like Customer master data, SAVM, SFDC, SHARE, PDB, PGTMV, CAV etc.  

Ability to handle high levels of ambiguity but seek clarification when needed

Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
